lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Multiple horizontal rows of high-luminance circular pixel clusters are visible posterior to the gill slits, forming a roughly staggered grid pattern across the mid-flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of increased pixel intensity intersect with the lateral blobs, creating identifiable anchor nodes within a rectangular grid-like arrangement.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A distinct horizontal linear feature is visible along the mid-lateral flank, characterized by a sharp luminance transition with lighter values on the dorsal side and darker shadow values on the ventral side.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A notable irregular high-intensity white patch is visible on the dorsal surface, situated approximately above the third and fourth gill slits.
other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple small, elongated low-intensity objects in the water column immediately adjacent to the ventral area and trailing the pectoral fin tip.
